title: 2.8.2  INFO: Pump unreachable
symptom: The phone starts to beep without any visible display, indicating the pump cannot be reached. This occurs after a bolus delivery with a wizard, and the alarm persists even with NS alarms switched off.
evidence_quote: Is with me also so, was already at 2.7 and 2.8 and also at 2.8.1, that my phone starts to beep without what is displayed. Only by the sound I know that the pump can not be reached.
